review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Hybrid Cloud
review_candidates.description: Full-time/ Huntsville, AL About Us Trideum Corporation is a 100% employee-owned company, committed to embracing the world’s toughest challenges with a servant’s heart. Through dedicated hard work and commitment, we provide distinctive quality and unparalleled customer service in all aspects of our business. We also know that our employees are the key to our success, and it is our mission to take care of them so they can take care of our customers and communities where we live, work, and play. Position Summary If you like owning the platform end to end, from the rack and the UPS to the Azure subscription, this role is built for you. You'll be the primary engineer for our two Dell Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI) clusters, our Veeam/Data Domain backup platform, and our Windows and Linux fleet, and you'll lead our growing Azure Government environment as we unify on-prem and cloud through Azure Arc. In this role you'll join an eight-person Infrastructure & Operations team, reporting to our Senior Systems Engineer. As a key member of the team, you'll take ownership of well-established critical infrastructure environment. A key part of this role is strengthening the team's operational resilience through thorough documentation, cross-training, and shared operational knowledge. What You’ll Do Run our two Azure Local clusters: Hyper-V and Storage Spaces Direct operations, lifecycle updates, capacity planning, and the VM fleet on them (including our GitLab CI runners). Administer Windows Server and Active Directory, plus a smaller RHEL/Ubuntu fleet (Satellite, IdM, Landscape). Own backup and recovery on Veeam and Data Domain, including proving that restores actually work. Lead day-to-day Azure Government administration: VM lifecycle, subscriptions, tagging and cost, Azure Policy, Key Vaults, RBAC, etc. Unify hybrid management across Azure Local and Azure Government with Azure Arc and Azure Update Manager. Own patching, vulnerability remediation, and STIG/CIS hardening, and produce evidence for our CMMC / NIST 800-171 assessments. Own the physical side: server and rack hardware, UPS maintenance, and facilities coordination for power and HVAC. Switches, firewalls, and Wi-Fi belong to the network team. Your first six months Take ownership of the Azure Local clusters and the backup platform from our departing lead, documenting as you go. Finish the OS parity work between Azure Local and Azure Government, then stand up Arc-based patching through Azure Update Manager across both. Take over Azure Government subscription, Key Vault, and RBAC administration from our senior systems engineer. What We Need You To Have Done Before 7+ years running production server infrastructure as the responsible engineer. Operated an Active Directory forest as the responsible admin: GPO baselines, domain controller health, identity recovery. Run a production Hyper-V or HCI cluster through at least one full lifecycle update. Azure Stack HCI / Azure Local is ideal; strong VMware vSAN engineers who want to convert are welcome. Owned a backup platform end to end, including restore testing. Administered Azure beyond portal basics (Government cloud preferred): subscriptions, RBAC, Key Vault, and enough PowerShell to automate the repetitive parts. Hardened Windows and Linux to STIG or CIS baselines and closed vulnerability findings in a compliance-driven environment; comfortable administering RHEL or Ubuntu alongside Windows. Requirements And Qualifications Certifications: Current Security+ (or a higher DoD 8140 cert) or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire, and Current AZ-104 or AZ-800/801 or ability to obtain within 12 months funded by our team's training budget. A bachelor’s degree is preferred, but experience in lieu of degree is fully considered. US citizenship with the ability to obtain a Secret security clearance. Desired Qualifications RHCSA, or real depth with Red Hat Satellite and IdM. Ansible, Terraform, or Bicep, and Git-based workflows (we run GitLab). Prior work in a DoD contractor / CMMC environment. Working conditions This position will work on-site at our Huntsville headquarters - you own physical infrastructure, so this role isn't remote work eligible. Core business hours are 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.; after-hours work is limited to scheduled maintenance windows, and genuine emergencies are rare. You'll occasionally lift and rack server hardware, so the ability to lift 25 lbs is required. We Take Care of Our People Whether You’re Looking To Launch a New Career Or Grow An Existing One, Trideum Is The Type Of Company Where You Can Balance Great Work With Great Life Because We Believe That Taking Care Of Our People Is The Right Thing To Do. Trideum Offers Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary. Traditional benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and 401k matching. Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Paid leave and the ability to cash out leave. Free access to certified financial planners, wellness and support services, and discount programs. Education assistance and professional development opportunities. And much more. Ready to Apply? Start Your Application now! Equal Opportunity Employer All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. People with disabilities who need a reasonable accommodation to apply or compete for employment with Trideum may request such accommodation(s) by contacting Human Resources at 256.704.6123 or HR@trideum.com.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer – Network Security & Wireless Network - Vice President
review_candidates.description: Position Overview Job Title Senior Network Engineer – Network Security & Wireless Network Corporate Title Vice President Location Cary, NC Who We Are In short – an essential part of Deutsche Bank’s technology solution, developing applications for key business areas. Our Technologists drive Cloud, Cyber and business technology strategy while transforming it within a robust, hands-on engineering culture. Learning is a key element of our people strategy, and we have a variety of options for you to develop professionally. Our approach to the future of work champions flexibility and is rooted in the understanding that there have been dramatic shifts in the ways we work. Having first established a presence in the Americas in the 19th century, Deutsche Bank opened its US technology center in Cary, North Carolina in 2009. Learn more about us here . Overview Deutsche Bank’s Global Network Services function delivers secure, resilient, and scalable network services across the Bank’s global technology estate. The Senior Network Engineer – Network Security & Wireless Network will be responsible to develop, shape, and deliver new network security solutions that strengthen the Bank’s cyber resilience and support secure technology transformation. Additionally, as a second focus area, the role requires strong collaboration with Network Core Engineering to deliver new wireless network solutions that improve end-user experience for Deutsche Bank Employees and clients, and support Deutsche Bank’s security standards. What We Offer You A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs What You’ll Do Lead the design and delivery of network security solutions, including Zero Trust, network segmentation, access control, firewall governance, secure connectivity, and cyber resilience capabilities Develop and enhance enterprise wireless network solutions, leveraging cloud-managed technologies, emerging vendors, industry best practices, and internal security standards Own end-to-end solution delivery from concept and business case development through design, implementation, operational transition, and value realization. Partner closely with Network Engineering and key stakeholders to align solution design, technical requirements, operational readiness, and change governance objectives Translate complex technical requirements into executable roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes while providing implementation and governance oversight Identify and remediate network security weaknesses by assessing control gaps, vulnerabilities, architectural risks, and operational issues, driving corrective actions through to closure How You’ll Lead Act as a senior interface with Network Engineering, CSO, Technology Risk, GTI, operations, architecture, vendors, and global business stakeholders on solution delivery, technical dependencies, implementation progress, and operational readiness Prepare high-quality reporting and presentations for senior management and committees Skills You’ll Need Strong technical understanding of network security technologies and architectures, including Cisco, Check Point, Fortinet, F5, firewalls, proxies, routing, segmentation, NAC, secure remote access, cloud connectivity, hybrid network controls, and enterprise security tooling Comprehensive knowledge of Wi-Fi standards (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax - Wi-Fi 6/6E), Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) from major vendors (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Meraki), Access Point (AP) deployment best practices, RF planning, site survey methodologies, and wireless security protocols (WPA2/3 Enterprise) Deep knowledge of network solution delivery, including design principles, control integration, operational resilience, technology risk management, and weakness remediation Familiarity with regulatory drivers for technology security (ECB, EBA, SOX, GLBA, Dodd-Frank, DORA, etc.). Proven ability to manage technical delivery of complex network security solutions while identifying security weaknesses, assessing risk, defining remediation priorities, and driving closure with engineering and operations teams Experience in a TISO, technical information security, security architecture, cyber risk, or comparable security advisory role would be beneficial, particularly where it involved solution design, security challenge, and remediation governance Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs Skills That Will Help You Excel Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to engage senior management with authority and clarity Technically curious, delivery-focused, and able to bridge the gap between engineering design, cyber security requirements, and practical implementation Strong leadership presence and ability to work under regulatory pressure Collaborative, internationally minded, and able to build strong cross-functional relationships Outcome-driven, structured, and committed to delivering secure, scalable, and operationally sustainable network security solutions Expectations It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the Cary, NC office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model. Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion. The salary range for this position in Cary is $125,000 to $185,000. Actual salaries may be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration. Deutsche Bank Benefits At Deutsche Bank, we recognize that our benefit programs have a profound impact on our colleagues. That’s why we are focused on providing benefits and perks that enable our colleagues to live authenti­cally and be their whole selves, at every stage of life. We provide access to physical, emotional, and financial wellness benefits that allow our colleagues to stay financially secure and strike balance between work and home. Click here to learn more! Learn more about your life at Deutsche Bank through the eyes of our current employees https://careers.db.com/life The California Consumer Privacy Act outlines how companies can use personal information. If you are interested in receiving a copy of Deutsche Bank’s California Privacy Notice please email HR.Direct@DB.com . We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group. We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Click these links to view "Deutsche Bank’s Equal Opportunity Policy Statement" and the following notices: "EEOC Know Your Rights" ; "Employee Rights and Responsibilities under the Family and Medical Leave Act" ; and "Employee Polygraph Protection Act" .

review_candidates.description: Job title : NOC Engineer (Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN & Fortinet) Type of employment: Full-time (Remote) Shift Schedule: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Mountain Time (Time can be identified once hired) We're looking for an NOC Engineer to provide Tier 2 NOC support by resolving escalations from Tier 1, coordinating with Field Support Teams (FSTs) and ISPs, performing advanced troubleshooting/equipment swaps, and supporting new install turnups to keep customer networks reliable and performing. About the Company: The company is an IT network management provider founded in 2008, evolving from routing engineering and customer support into a holistic solution set focused on flexibility, capability, and agility for enterprise customers. Objective of this role: Provide reliable Tier 2 NOC support to ensure stable client network operations Support technicians and field teams during deployments, troubleshooting, and installation activities Free up senior engineers for high-value client initiatives by providing dedicated operational support Deliver high-quality troubleshooting, escalation handling, and incident resolution Contribute to a highly accountable and solution-oriented engineering culture Develop the ability to independently manage support activities and technician coordination within the first 6 months Responsibilities: Tier 2 Network Support Act as the secondary escalation point for Tier 1 technicians and support queues Troubleshoot network-related incidents involving routing, switching, VPNs, WAN connectivity, and firewall environments Provide remote troubleshooting support via phone and remote access tools Support break-fix activities and ensure timely issue resolution Field Support Team (FST) Coordination Collaborate with FSTs (ISPs, clients, CIS technicians) to ensure smooth check-ins and check-outs during support operations. Break-Fix, Turnups, and Advanced Troubleshooting Manage and resolve break-fix issues and oversee turnups of new installations. Perform equipment swaps and advanced troubleshooting (remote access + limited configuration updates such as WAN IP changes). Dispatch, Equipment Requests, and Billing Support Submit dispatch requests for on-site support when required. Handle equipment replacement requests for non-ISP equipment. Identify and submit billing discrepancies for resolution. Branch Test and Turnup Take primary responsibility for turnup projects when assigned. When not on turnups, operate as Tier 2 support with the same responsibilities and access as other Tier 2 technicians. Required skills and qualifications: 2+ years of experience in a Technical Support, Network Operations Center (NOC), or Network Support role. Strong Managed Services Provider (MSP) background required. Proven experience performing Tier 2+ network troubleshooting, including firewalls, VPNs, network/site outages, and connectivity issues. Hands-on experience supporting Cisco Meraki, Fortinet and Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN environments. Hands-on experience in Prisma SD-WAN firmware upgrades and device support (e.g., break/fix, hardware replacements). Strong networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, and related protocols. Familiarity with network technologies and protocols such as BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN, IPsec VPNs, and WAN troubleshooting. Experience managing firewall policies, network appliances, and network security devices. Experience supporting network infrastructure rather than PC or cloud-only environments. Knowledge of network operations, incident response processes, and SLA-driven triage. Experience with change management, production deployments, rollback planning, and firmware/patch management for network and security devices. Ability to coordinate effectively with ISPs, vendors, remote users, and field technicians to resolve network issues. Experience using remote access and network troubleshooting tools. Strong communication and customer service skills, including phone-based troubleshooting and stakeholder communication. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and escalations simultaneously. Preferred skills and qualifications Networking certifications such as Cisco CCNA, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, or similar. Experience with SolarWinds or other network monitoring, visibility, and troubleshooting tools. Experience supporting ISP cutovers, branch turn-up projects, and site deployments. Exposure to Palo Alto, Zabbix, or similar networking platforms and monitoring solutions. Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, network diagrams, and installation guides using Visio, Draw.io, or similar tools. Previous experience in Tier 2 or Tier 3 support environments. Experience providing remote support and guidance to on-site field technicians.

review_candidates.description: WHO WE ARE Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story. THE OPPORTUNITY We're hiring a Senior Support Engineer as a founding member of our Identity Customer Success organization. You'll be the technical lifeline for our most strategic enterprise accounts and help architect how the support function operates from day one. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, identity security, and AI-driven workflow design. You'll diagnose the most complex issues across our customers' environments, help build the systems and processes the support team will run on for years, and partner with Product and Engineering as a trusted technical resource. You’re a builder, not just a ticket-taker. If you want to inherit a mature support org and operate inside it, this may not be the right fit. But if you are excited about building a support function from the ground up, we’d love to talk. RESPONSIBILITIES: Lead the end-to-end resolution of complex issues across our enterprise customer base - driving everything from initial triage and bug reproduction to root-cause analysis, technical fixes, and client-facing communication. Resolve complex issues across customer identity stacks in both SaaS and on-premise environments. Investigate distributed systems and data pipeline issues across our platform - debugging NXLog collectors, S3 ingestion pipelines, MongoDB query behaviors, asynchronous jobs, and Datadog logs. Partner with Product and Engineering as an equal stakeholder. Reproduce bugs cleanly, file high-quality, detailed engineering tickets, and quantify customer health signals to prioritize the right fixes. Build the support knowledge base from scratch - customer-facing troubleshooting guides, internal runbooks, and integration playbooks. Own critical escalations so customers leave a Sev-1 with more confidence in us than they had going in. You’ll get to build AI agents using Claude, Gemini, and MCP servers that automate L1/L2 triage, log analysis, and case routing across Slack, Linear, and Pylon. Define SLAs, support KPI’s, escalation paths, on-call rotation, and internal workflows with TAMs, Solution Architects, and Engineering. Who You Are You possess excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with a proven track record of remaining calm, articulate, and methodical during severe technical escalations or system outages. Attention to detail is a part of your MO. Nothing slips through the cracks with you, even under pressure. Sev-1s, escalations, fast-paced environments, and changing priorities don't phase you. You listen before you troubleshoot, solving for the customer rather than just trying to close a ticket. Cross-collaboration across different teams and stakeholders comes naturally to you, keeping customer success at the center of everything. Grounded in deep identity expertise, but always willing to learn what’s next. You are relentlessly results-oriented, working hand-in-hand to align customer success with company goals while maintaining the drive to deliver your best work when the stakes are high. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: 6+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or customer-facing engineering within cybersecurity. Direct background in identity security — IAM, PAM, IGA, or non-human identity — is required. Deep, hands-on experience working with core identity stacks (like Okta, Entra ID, or Active Directory), identity governance platforms (like SailPoint), and PAM solutions (like CyberArk or BeyondTrust). Working knowledge of AWS, GCP, and Azure IAM. Strong fluency in SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, and mTLS — you can read a SAML response and tell me why it's failing. Practical experience with cloud security models across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including configured role policies, trust relationships, Azure Service Principals/Enterprise Applications, and GCP Service Accounts. Working knowledge of service accounts, API keys, tokens, certificates, secrets rotation, ephemeral credentials, and JIT access. Hands-on with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or GCP Secret Manager. Strong observability instincts with hands-on experience utilizing enterprise logging and SIEM solutions (such as Datadog or Splunk). Fluent in SQL, JSON, YAML, and HCL. Advanced troubleshooting with HTTP debugging, analyzing HAR traces, and reading Go or TypeScript stack traces. Comfortable integrating AI tools directly into your daily support workflow. You know how to build effective prompts and collaborate with AI agents to constantly improve and speed up how we handle cases. A genuine passion for advocating for customer success within a complex, fast-paced technical environment. Exceptional relationship management and multi-channel communication skills, with the ability to represent Cyera confidently and clearly under pressure to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
